advisory.finding: No regression test pins the documented precision contract that a bare commit hash / Gerrit change number produces NO citation. The docstring states 'commit hashes and Gerrit change numbers deliberately do not fire' (they are ADR-0043's required attestation-event provenance), but the only commit-hash-bearing test (test_live_grunion_ac19_text_fires) is dominated by a test-path citation and asserts only that the path IS in cites — it never asserts the hash is absent. A future change that made a citation pattern match hex/number tokens would block legitimate external ACs and no test would fail.
scenarios: A refactor widens a citation regex (or adds a hex/number pattern) so a commit SHA or Gerrit change number is treated as repo evidence — legitimately external attested ACs carrying only attestation-event provenance would be blocked at close, and the suite would stay green.
